summary: Backend-only review of PerksLocks parlay overhaul. 8 pytest cases against /api/picks/parlay (V1.1) and /api/picks/today. RESULTS: 6 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED, 1 FAILED. T1 PASS (top-parlay leg win_probability = [96.0, 96.0], range across all 3 cards = 63.3–96.0, every leg ≥60). T2 SKIPPED (high-risk Soccer-only built 0 parlays — endpoint clamps high_risk target_legs to a floor of 10 regardless of user `legs` param at server.py:1262, so legs=5 silently becomes 10, and today's soccer slate has too few high_risk-qualifying picks). T3 PASS (refresh_nonce changes parlay signature). T4 FAIL (parlay_history collection has 0 documents after 3 hits — `record_parlay_shown` is dead code at server.py:1487, sitting AFTER the active V1.1 endpoint's `return` at server.py:1370). T5 PASS ('Parlay Learning: settled=0 (won=0 lost=0 push=0) | 0 synergy rows' present in backend.err.log — wiring runs). T6 PASS on most-recent cycle (latest 'Self-heal validator' at 05:34:12 → fixed_lock=0). HOWEVER: scanning the last 10 validator cycles reveals a cyclic-churn pattern — fixed_lock alternates between 0/5 (3 cycles) and 106-265 (7 cycles). The user's 106-pick complaint scenario STILL recurs every 2nd-3rd cycle (05:31:16 → 110, 05:23:50 → 265, 05:01:35 → 106, 04:30:21 → 106, 04:26:49 → 106, 04:11:54 → 176, 04:08:35 → 107). So while the literal review criterion (latest cycle <50) passes, the underlying drift bug is only partly fixed. T7a PASS (desc [73.0, 72.8, 72.5, 72.2, 71.7]). T7b PASS (asc [56.0, 56.2, 57.3, 58.1, 58.3]).

critical.issue: parlay_history is NEVER populated. The active V1.1 endpoint (server.py:1191 def pick_parlay → return at server.py:1370) does NOT call record_parlay_shown. The legacy V1 block that DOES call it (server.py:1483-1493) is unreachable code sitting AFTER the V1.1 return (lines 1371-1511 are inside pick_parlay but post-return). Mongo db.parlay_history.count_documents({}) = 0 after 3 endpoint hits. Fix: insert the record_parlay_shown loop into the V1.1 endpoint just before the `return {...}` at line 1353, and DELETE the dead V1 block at lines 1371-1511.

Validator drift fix is PARTIAL. The latest cycle shows fixed_lock=0 (passes review criterion <50), but scanning the last 10 cycles reveals a 30/70 oscillation: 7 of 10 cycles still rewrite 106-265 picks per cycle. Recent failing cycles: 05:31:16 fixed_lock=110, 05:23:50 fixed_lock=265, 05:01:35 fixed_lock=106, 04:30:21 fixed_lock=106, 04:26:49 fixed_lock=106. Root cause: edge_percent is recomputed first (fixed_edge=115 in those cycles) and that cascade into compute_lock_score still exceeds the new 6.0-point tolerance for ~110 picks. Widening from 1.0→6.0 was insufficient. Fixes: (a) widen tolerance to 10-12, or (b) snapshot edge_percent BEFORE step 3 and pass that snapshot into compute_lock_score, or (c) skip the lock branch for any pick that had its edge updated in step 3 of the same iteration.

minor.issue: When mode=high_risk, server.py:1262 hard-clamps target_legs = max(10, min(20, ...)) which overrides any user `legs` value < 10. Request `legs=5&mode=high_risk` silently becomes 10 legs. The review spec's Test #2 (5-leg Soccer high_risk) is therefore impossible to satisfy as written — endpoint always demands ≥10 legs. Either lower the floor to 5 to honor smaller bets, or expose the 10-leg minimum in OpenAPI.

When no parlay can be built, the 'reason' message is hardcoded to 'need Lock>=88, Edge>=+3%, positive ROI' (server.py:1344) regardless of mode. In high_risk mode the actual thresholds are Lock>=70/75 & Edge>=+1% — the message misleads the user. Make the thresholds mode-aware in the reason string.

Requesting legs=3 returned a top card (parlays[0]) with only 2 legs (parlays[1] had the requested 3 legs, parlays[2] had 2 legs). The legacy 'parlay' field maps to parlays[1] (line 1354), but consumers reading parlays[0] (highest-survival card) get a shorter card than requested. Document or normalize so all top parlays match the requested leg count.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Add the record_parlay_shown loop to the live /api/picks/parlay endpoint (server.py:1190-1370) just before its `return {...}` at line 1353. The current invocation at server.py:1483-1493 is unreachable dead code (post-return inside pick_parlay).
DELETE the dead duplicate V1 block at server.py:1371-1511 — it sits after the V1.1 return and is confusing (looked like a separate endpoint at first glance).

FIX (HIGH): Reduce validator lock_score churn further. 7/10 recent cycles still rewrite 106-265 picks. Either widen tolerance from 6.0 → 10-12.0, OR snapshot edge_percent before recompute and feed the snapshot into compute_lock_score, OR skip the lock branch when fixed_edge just fired for the same pick.
FIX (MINOR): Remove the high_risk min-10-legs floor at server.py:1262, OR honor legs=5 properly. Right now `mode=high_risk&legs=5` is silently overridden to 10.
FIX (MINOR): Make the no-parlay 'reason' string mode-aware (server.py:1344) — currently always claims Lock>=88/Edge>=+3% even for high_risk requests.
VERIFY: After record_parlay_shown is wired AND parlays actually settle, T5 should show non-zero 'settled=N' and 'synergy rows>0'. Today's settled=0 is expected (no legs settled yet).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1191-1511 — single function `pick_parlay` is 320 lines long with a hard `return` at line 1370 and a stale V1 body underneath (lines 1371-1511) that is dead code. The V1 body imports parlay_to_payload, builds payloads, and calls record_parlay_shown — none of which ever executes. Copy-paste hangover from the rewrite. Must be deleted, and the record_parlay_shown call moved into the active V1.1 body.
server.py:1262 — target_legs floor of 10 for high_risk is too aggressive for a user who explicitly asks for legs=5. Either treat legs as a hard cap or document the floor in the OpenAPI hint.

pick_validator.py:164 — tolerance of 6.0 is empirically insufficient: cyclic-churn pattern shows 7/10 recent cycles still rewrite 106-265 picks. With fixed_edge firing on 115/281 picks per cycle, the edge→lock cascade produces >6pt swings on ~39% of picks. Recommend: snapshot pre-recompute edge_percent and pass it into compute_lock_score, OR skip lock branch when this pick was in the fixed_edge set this iteration.
parlay_learning.py:49 record_parlay_shown signature dedupes by signature, so spammy refreshes won't pollute the collection. Good defensive design.
server.py:1262 — target_legs formula for standard is max(2, min(8, ...)) which allows 2-leg parlays even on a legs=3 request (observed in T1, parlays[0] has 2 legs). Confusing for callers.
parlay_optimizer.py:296 — W_WIN_PROB at 30% looks correct. Top legs land at win_p=96, which would not happen if win_p were ignored as before. T1 confirms this works.

rca_of_issue: RCA #1 (T4 parlay_history empty): The /api/picks/parlay endpoint was rewritten as V1.1 (server.py:1191-1370) but the old V1 implementation was left in place starting at line 1371 with NO @api decorator. Both blocks live inside the single async def pick_parlay function — the active one returns at line 1370, so lines 1371-1511 are completely unreachable. The unreachable block contains the only call to record_parlay_shown in the codebase. Reproduction: curl /api/picks/parlay?legs=3 → 200 OK; then `await db.parlay_history.count_documents({})` returns 0. Fix: move the for-loop at server.py:1486-1493 to just before the V1.1 return at line 1353, and delete lines 1371-1511. RCA #2 (T6 cyclic churn): pick_validator.py runs in a fixed order — step 3 recomputes edge_percent (~115 picks updated per cycle), then step 4 recomputes lock_score using the freshly-updated edge_percent via compute_lock_score(pick=p, ...). When the edge shift exceeds the new 6.0-point lock tolerance, lock_score is rewritten too, producing fixed_lock=106-265 on 7/10 recent cycles. The 3 cycles that show fixed_lock=0 are the ones where edge happened not to shift (fixed_edge=5 in those cases). Fix: snapshot edge_percent BEFORE step 3 and pass the snapshot into compute_lock_score, OR skip step 4 for any pick that hit step 3 in the same iteration, OR widen the tolerance to 10-12 points (cosmetic but unblocks the user complaint).
